title: Sam Altman's ChatGPT Idea vs. Talking to Kids #shorts
description: Sam Altman suggested using AI to create personalized daily podcasts for kids, covering their schedules and interests. The internet's response? 'Or you could just talk to your kids.' This idea sparked massive debate, highlighting a divide on AI's role in personal relationships. #SamAltman #ChatGPT #AI #FamilyTech #Parenting

top_comments.author: @JordanJordi-d4d
top_comments.text: I work on human-robot interaction and even I think this is a stretch. Some interfaces should just be human.

top_reply.author: @STARTUPHAKK_sh
top_reply.text: I hear you — not every problem needs a robot in the middle of it, and pushing tech where a human touch works better just feels off. HRI gets interesting when it augments instead of replaces, but the line gets blurry fast. Where do you think robots actually add value instead of getting in the way?

top_comments.author: @bluehead_info
top_comments.text: How detached from reality he is?

top_reply.author: @STARTUPHAKK_sh
top_reply.text: Fair question. I’m looking at it from a different angle than most people. What do you think I’m missing?
